imagery: No photographs, illustrations, charts, or diagrams. Only decorative/badge graphics: the red border rectangle and the yellow '35' oval badge; plus a captured mouse cursor overlay near 'Layer Normalization'.
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Verdana/Arial-like) and bold throughout. Title is the largest (~36-40pt equivalent), red, title-case, centered. 'Adding' and the three list lines are the same blue, bold, sentence-case; list lines are indented under 'Adding' with no bullet glyphs, numbers, or markers — plain indented text lines. Badge number is small (~12-14pt) dark text. No italics, no all-caps.
animation_state: Slide appears fully revealed (lead-in word plus all three list items visible). A recorded mouse cursor sits over 'Layer Normalization', indicating a paused mid-lecture moment rather than a mid-build; no partially-faded or half-drawn elements detected.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E9E9E9). 2. Draw a rectangle from ~5% to ~95% width and ~7% to ~95% height with no fill and a thin red (#C00000) outline to form the border frame. 3. Add a text box centered horizontally at ~25%-35% height containing 'Building Transformer Block' in bold red (#C00000) sans-serif (Verdana), ~40pt. 4. Add a left-aligned text box starting at ~12% x, ~52% y with 'Adding' in bold blue (#1A1AB8), ~28pt. 5. In the same or a nested text box indented to ~21% x, add three lines, each bold blue ~28pt, in this order: 'Residual Connections', 'Layer Normalization', 'Feed Forward Network', with normal line spacing and no bullet characters. 6. Draw a small oval (~4% wide) at the top-right inside the border (~91% x, ~13% y), filled yellow (#FDFD96) with a dark purple (#4B0082) outline, and add centered dark text '35' (~12pt). 7. Optionally add a solid black rectangle across the full bottom edge (~4% tall) only if replicating the video letterboxing; otherwise omit as it is not slide content. 8. Do not add the mouse cursor — it is a recording artifact.
